description: AOS availability, Ax32Serv/w3wp process health, IIS web services, and host capacity for Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012. Pair with profiles/dynamics-ax-2012.yml. App-level Batch/DMF/Reporting needs extra collectors beyond windows_exporter.

targets.expr: count(((100 * (1 - avg by(instance) (rate(windows_cpu_time_total{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",mode="idle"}[5m])))) and on(instance) (count by(instance) (windows_service_state{job=~"${job:regex}",instance=~"${instance:regex}",name=~"(?i)AOS60\\\\$.+"}))) > 85) or vector(0)
